title: Qualitative discovery (the why)
purpose: Quant tells you where; only talking to people tells you why. Mix methods so you are not over-indexing on one bias.
north_star: Wishlist / consideration → purchase conversion on Myntra
recruit_rule: Recruit from Phase 1 cells (category × price × tenure × wishlist size), not a generic wishlist panel.
output: Reason inventory (what exists) + frequency check (what is common): item-level clusters, off-platform PDP gaps, comparison criteria, large-N micro-survey shares.
status_note: Diaries, live wishlist sessions, and in-app surveys are not in the public-VOC pipeline. Public reviews can seed codes; they cannot replace in-the-moment logging.

survey_triggers.question: What changed your mind?
survey_triggers.codes: found cheaper elsewhere / not sure about fit / changed my mind on style / no longer needed / other

survey_triggers.trigger: Open a wishlist item after 14+ days inactive
survey_triggers.question: What's holding you back on this one?
survey_triggers.codes: same codebook + forgot / no occasion yet

methods.title: Contextual / diary studies (highest value)
methods.sample: 15–20 users who wishlisted in the last 7 days and have not bought.
methods.job: Log in the moment (not recall) what happens between I like this and I didn’t buy it: reviews elsewhere, ask someone, cheaper price, distraction, decide against.
methods.bias_it_avoids: Recall interviews sand down messy behavior (Instagram reels + WhatsApp opinion).

methods.title: Task-based usability (live wishlist)
methods.sample: Users walk their actual wishlist, item by item.
methods.job: Why is this still here? What’s stopping you? What would make you buy it right now?
methods.bias_it_avoids: Aggregate answers hide several distinct clusters inside one person’s list.

methods.title: In-app micro-surveys
methods.sample: Large-N, single question, at high-signal moments.
methods.job: Remove-without-buy: What changed your mind? Open after 14+ days: What’s holding you back?
methods.bias_it_avoids: 15–20 interviews mislead on relative frequency even when they are great at listing reasons.

methods.title: Off-platform (ask; you cannot track competitors)
methods.job: Before buying this wishlisted item, did you check anywhere else? Where? What did you look for?
methods.bias_it_avoids: In-app logs miss other retailers, Google reviews, Reddit sizing, group chat, haul videos.

methods.title: Comparison-shopping shadowing
methods.sample: Users with 3+ near-duplicate wishlisted items (e.g. 4 similar kurtas).
methods.job: Think-aloud: which one would you actually buy, and on what criteria?
methods.bias_it_avoids: UI may not support the real criteria (fabric, returns, who else bought this).
